verify.summary:
I re-fetched korter (curl plus INITIAL_STATE parse), kn.kz, metry, the krisha complex pages, about 25 krisha ads via the /kz/ mirror, and 2GIS, and re-read the saved kn.kz cards and kapster. Nearly every quoted date is verbatim and current as of 14.10.2026. The korter quarters per section, korter's permit notes, metry's per-block quarters, kn.kz's per-address table and the krisha queue lists all match exactly. Key ad quotes are confirmed:
- D: 'Дата передачи ключей: 10.10.2026'; title changed from 'КЛЮЧИ В ИЮЛЕ' to 'КЛЮЧИ В октября'.
- K: 'Выдача ключей — 15 октября!', after slipping from June–July to August to September.
- E: 'Срок сдачи в декабре 2026 года'.
- H: 'Ключи в феврале 2027г.'
- M: 'Срок сдачи 2027 году в марте'.
- G: 'III квартал 2027'.
- TARIH B: 21.10 keys / 28.11.2026 and 21–28 November.
- TARIH C and E: March 2027.
- 2GIS: 'блок К уже 3 раз переносят сроки'.

Errors found:
- (1) Ad 1015384574's 'Q1 2027' belongs to block M, not C.
- (2) Some cited 'A delivered' ads name no block, and one is at Улы Дала 14. A's delivery is still confirmed by three ads that name A.
- (3) kn.kz addresses, especially '14 стр', are catch-alls, so the A slip history built from unnamed kn.kz ads is weak.
- (4) The korter start dates are not uniformly 2025 Q4.
- (5) The 2GIS 'March 2028' comment dates from around October 2025.

The overall picture holds:
- A and B: delivered.
- D and K: handover in October 2026.
- E and C: December 2026.
- H: February 2027.
- M: March 2027.
- F: June 2027, with one September 2027 outlier.
- G: Q3 2027.
- TARIH A and B: November 2026.
- TARIH C and E: March 2027.

Imagery-only estimate of the physical stage of every DARYN and TARIH block. Sources: Sentinel-2 L2A at 10 m (about 40 scenes from Sep 2024 to 13 Oct 2026, including Dec–Mar snow scenes with high-contrast shadows), the high-resolution Google mosaic, and Esri Wayback. Esri Wayback metadata dates its imagery to 2024-09-17, when the whole site was bare steppe, so every block was built after that.

The Google mosaic is undated. Its blurred content correlates best with S2 of 15 Jul 2026 (r=0.96, against 0.75–0.90 for nearby dates), so I treat it as about July 2026. Registration between S2 and the local frame is within ±2–6 m.

Heights come from shadow length × tan(sun elevation). Shadows were measured along each scene's anti-solar azimuth from a wall point read off the Google footprint. The time-stack strips (st_*.png) carry a height ruler per date.

CALIBRATION (fact-based within this cluster):
- B topped out about Oct 2025 and was occupied or commissioned by about mid-2026.
- A topped out about Nov–Dec 2025 and was delivered by Oct 2026 (owner ad).
- D topped out about Nov 2025; the owner ad says keys Nov 2026.
- E topped out about Feb–Mar 2026; the BI sheet says 24.12.2026.
- K's main part topped out about Jan–Feb 2026; the BI sheet says 17.10.2026.

So BI's own topping-out-to-keys interval here is about 8–12 months, slower than the generic 4–9. I used 8–12 months (base about 10) for the realistic window. Treat 6 months as an aggressive floor.

RESULTS:
- Delivered: DARYN A and B.
- Topped out and finishing, keys plausible Q4 2026 – Q1 2027: DARYN D (Oct 2026 – Jan 2027), DARYN E (Dec 2026 – Mar 2027), K's main part (Oct 2026 – Feb 2027), TARIH A (Oct 2026 – Jan 2027) and TARIH B (Dec 2026 – Mar 2027).
- TARIH C topped out about Jun–Jul 2026, so keys about Mar – Jul 2027.
- Rose in mid-2026 and are only now at or near full height: DARYN C1 (frame went up Jun–Aug 2026), C2–C3, F, G (G6 still rising), H, K's NE part and TARIH E. Realistic keys for these are mid to late 2027.
- DARYN M was at about 1–5 floors in Oct 2026, so keys about 2028.
- The lot A building has piles only.

This contradicts the BI and owner dates for:
- C ('26.12.2026', 'Q4 2026')
- H (27.02.2027)
- M (31.03.2027)
- TARIH E (Q1 2027)
- K's NE part, if the 17.10.2026 date is meant for the whole of K.

LIMITS OF 10 m IMAGERY (explicit):
- Height precision is about ±1 pixel along the shadow: ±6 m (±2 floors) at 31° sun, ±17 m in midsummer.
- Wall positions are ±5–10 m. Shadows falling on neighbouring buildings, closed courtyards, podiums, asphalt or dark ground truncate or inflate the measurement. Several values (C2–C3, G5, K courtyard, TARIH A/B courtyards, H over lot A) are bounds or ranges only.
- It cannot tell a topped-out frame from a last floor still in formwork. It cannot show façade, windows, MEP, heating or power hook-up, lifts, finishing, landscaping in detail, the state commissioning act, or whether keys are actually being handed.
- It cannot separate individual sections inside a block, or tell which section a given office is in.
- The topping-out months are inferred from plateaus between scenes that can be 4–8 weeks apart. Handover windows are model estimates, not facts.

Images are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-ispeo-saraptama-kz/9c75da6f-017a-59fc-9a5e-c9e0d03d9df9/scratchpad/geo/handover_imagery/:
- Overview montages: mont_2024_2025.png, mont_2025H2.png, mont_snow.png, mont_2026.png
- Strips: st_E_D.png, st_B_A.png, st_K.png, st_C_M_H.png, st_M_L.png, st_G_F.png, st_F.png, st_TARIH.png, st_TAB_NW.png
- Block montages: bm_C_M.png, bm_west.png, bm_HG_2026.png, bm_TARIH_winter.png
- Footprint check crops: work/gz_*.png
- Scripts: scripts/
conflicts: DARYN C: the owner ad says 'передача ключей 26.12.2026' and the BI CSV says C Q4 2026. Imagery shows C1 with no shadow up to 2 Jun 2026 and its frame rising Jun–Aug 2026. C2–C3 were low in Jul 2026 and only tall by Sep 2026. Keys before about mid-2027 are not credible.

DARYN H: the BI sheet says 27.02.2027. H was still a rising frame with cranes in Jul 2026 and was only near full height in Sep–Nov 2026, so 3–5 months to keys would be far faster than this cluster's observed 8–12.
DARYN M: the BI sheet says 31.03.2027 and the BI CSV Q1 2027. M was a bare raft in Jul 2026 and about 1–5 floors on 13 Oct 2026, so about 2028 is realistic.
DARYN K: the BI sheet says 17.10.2026. That fits the W column and S bar (topped out about Jan–Feb 2026), but not the NE part, which rose Jul–Oct 2026 (possibly korter 'K-2').

DARYN A: korter's 'A Q4 2027' conflicts with the imagery (built and landscaped by about Jul 2026) and with the owner ad 'ключи на руках'. metry's 'A Q2 2026' is earlier than the about Nov–Dec 2025 topping-out allows, so Q3 2026 is more likely.
DARYN D: metry says Q3 2026 and the owner ad says Nov 2026. Topping-out was about Nov 2025, so the owner date fits and Q3 2026 probably slipped.
TARIH E: BI says Q1 2027, but the SE part was still a frame in Jul 2026 and the north bar only reached about 9 floors in Sep–Oct 2026.
TARIH C: BI says Q1 2027. Topping-out was about Jun–Jul 2026, so Q1 2027 would need only about 8–9 months: possible but at the optimistic edge.
The C1 height plateau of about 35–37 m in Sep–Oct 2026 is below the reported 17-floor design (about 52 m). Either the wall position estimate is off by about 10 m or C1 was not yet topped out.
gaps: The Google mosaic is undated. I estimated about Jul 2026 from correlation with S2 (best 15 Jul 2026), which is not a stated acquisition date.
Section-level heights inside blocks (E1–E5, D tower vs slab, F sections, G5, the H sections, M4–M7) are not separable at 10 m. Several are lower bounds or ranges only.

TARIH A and B absolute heights could not be measured cleanly, because their shadows fall on DARYN F/G, the Аллея and courtyard podiums. Their topping-out months come from qualitative snow-scene shadow extent.
The TARIH E SE part gave no measurable shadow, so its height in Oct 2026 is unknown.
The 8–12 month topping-out-to-keys interval is calibrated from only five BI blocks in this cluster, partly using owner ads and BI sheet dates as the 'keys' end.
No sub-metre imagery after about Jul 2026 was available, so the Aug–Oct 2026 status rests on 10 m S2 only.
Commissioning acts, utility connections and actual key handover cannot be observed from orbit. These need on-site checks, the BI sales office, or the state commissioning register (акт ввода).
Lot A building: use and size are unknown. It is piles only.

checked.claim: Esri Wayback imagery at the site is dated 2024-09-17 (bare steppe), so all blocks were built after that
checked.evidence: I re-queried the Wayback metadata (scripts/wbmeta.py) for the releases of 2026-05-28, 06-30, 08-05 and 09-24. All four return SRC_DATE2 2024-09-17, 0.31 m, 'Vivid Advanced'. Even the newest Esri release has no 2025–26 capture.

checked.claim: The undated Google mosaic is about July 2026 (best correlation r=0.96 with S2 of 15 Jul 2026)
checked.evidence: I re-ran regcheck.py. Correlations were 0428 0.625, 0602 0.702, 0620 0.798, 0709 0.847, 0715 0.957, 0730 0.901, 0814 0.905, 0908 0.837 and 1013 0.633. The tiles also carry a '© 2026 Google' watermark. Caveat: the correlation is partly driven by shadow geometry, so 'late Jun – mid Aug 2026' is the honest window. It is not a stated acquisition date.

checked.claim: DARYN A and B are built, landscaped and occupied by about Jul 2026 (delivered)
checked.evidence: Google crop handover_verify_imagery/g_AK.png and g_B.png: A has a finished perimeter and a landscaped courtyard with playgrounds. B is finished, with rows of parked cars on its west side. OSM way 1478765471 is 'ЖК ŪIA.DARYN Блок B', Улы Дала 10, building:levels 14, at local (490,−271). Imagery cannot prove the commissioning act or key handover. 'Delivered' rests on the owner ads plus physical completion.

checked.claim: B: about 35 m on 2025-09-25, about 41 m on 2025-10-28, then a 39–43 m plateau; topped out about Oct 2025
checked.evidence: Automated probe re-run (handover_verify_imagery/sh.json), B: 39 (09-25), 41 (10-28), 41 (11-19), then 36–41 through 2026-10-13. The summer 2026 values of 27–39 are noisy. It also gives about 15–17 m on 2025-03-02 and 07-20, so B was already partly up in spring 2025.

checked.claim: DARYN D topped out about Nov 2025 (about 33 m on 2025-09-25, about 46 m on 2025-10-28), with a 48–53 m plateau
checked.evidence: Probe D_N: 46 m on 2025-09-25, 51 on 10-28, 49 on 11-19, and about 45–51 through 2026-10-13. My strip st_A_early.png (D175) shows the shadow tip at about +55 m on 09-25 (el 37, about 41 m) and about +80 m on 10-10 (el 32, about 50 m). So D was at or near full height by about early or mid Oct 2025, about a month earlier than claimed. Its plateau is about 45–51 m, not 48–53. The 'ключи ноябрь 2026' fit still holds, at about 13 months after topping-out. Mapping 'D = Улы Дала 4' is an inference: OSM way 1478765467 at (176,−190) is named only 'ЖК ŪIA.DARYN' with no block letter.

checked.claim: DARYN E (Улы Дала 10а) rose Sep 2025 – Mar 2026 and has a 50–54 m plateau from 2026-04-28
checked.evidence: OSM way 1478765469 'ЖК ŪIA.DARYN блок Е', Улы Дала 10а, at (54,−138). Probe E_N: 20 (09-25), 31 (10-28), 39 (11-19), 46 (02-15), 48 (02-25), 51 (03-27), 52 (04-28), then 49–52 through 10-13. Google (g_FG.png) shows E finished, with a crane still on site.

checked.claim: DARYN C1 had no shadow up to 2026-06-02 'at el 60°, where even a 15 m building would show'; its frame rose Jun–Aug 2026; it was 35–37 m on 09-08, 09-20, 10-07 and 10-13; and Google (Jul) shows it 'tall with a crane'
checked.evidence: Snow scenes of 2025-12-27, 2026-02-15 and 02-25 show the whole C box white with no shadow, so C1 had no significant structure before late Feb 2026 (mont_mid.png, mont_C_spring.png). The '15 m would show' reasoning is wrong: at el 60° a 15 m building casts an 8.7 m shadow, under one 10 m S2 pixel, so 06-02 does not prove C1 was absent. In Google (g_C1.png), C1's shadow offset is about 12–15 m against B's about 25 m (B is 14 fl.), so C1 was roughly half-height (about 20–25 m) in Jul, not 'tall'. My strips (st_C1_H.png) give the shadow tip at about +15–25 m on 09-08 (about 15–24 m high), about +35–45 on 09-20 (about 28–37 m) and about +55–60 on 10-07 and 10-13 (about 33–39 m). The auto probe gives 6, 0, 17 and 24 m, because the tip falls on the dark avenue. So 35–37 m is supported only for October; C1 was still rising in Sep–Oct. The conclusion that C is not handed over in Dec 2026 is, if anything, strengthened.

checked.claim: DARYN M (sections 4–7) was two bare raft slabs in Jul 2026 and about 1–5 floors on 13 Oct 2026, so 31.03.2027 is unachievable
checked.evidence: Google g_CMH.png: two bare concrete slabs at x 300–335, y −180…−245 and −280…−345, with no walls. Probe M7: 0 on every date up to 2026-10-07 and 5 m on 10-13. Reaching keys by 31.03.2027 from 1–5 floors in mid-October is not physically plausible. The '2028' window is a model estimate.

checked.claim: The lot A building is piles only, with no above-ground structure up to Oct 2026
checked.evidence: Google g_CMH.png shows a pile field with materials and piling rigs at x 360–450, y −170…−260. The LotA probe found no shadow on any of the 19 dates through 2026-10-13.

checked.claim: DARYN H was a frame rising in Jul 2026 and near full height only Sep–Nov 2026, so BI 27.02.2027 is too early (keys Jul–Nov 2027)
checked.evidence: Google g_H.png (about Jul 2026): the north section (x 350–410, y −275…−305), the east tower (x 400–430, y −305…−345, already carrying a roof structure) and the SW section all cast NW shadows offset about 20–25 m. That is comparable to B's about 25 m (14 fl.). So H's main sections were already near B's height in about Jul 2026, not merely 'rising'. The S2 figure of 36–45 m on 09-20 and 10-13 is not reproducible: the auto probe gives 8–11 m, and my strips are ambiguous because lot A's dark ground sits behind them. Topping-out is more likely about Jul–Sep 2026. That makes 27.02.2027 aggressive (about 6–8 months) but not clearly impossible.

checked.claim: DARYN K: the W column and S bar topped out about Jan–Feb 2026; the NE part was a low frame in Jul 2026 and rose to about 45 m by Sep–Oct 2026
checked.evidence: Google g_AK.png confirms the W column, S bar and SE tower are finished with a landscaped courtyard. It also confirms the NE part (x 575–665, y −330…−395) is a low frame with formwork. Snow scenes show tall shadows inside K already on 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-18, so the main part was up by about Dec 2025 – Feb 2026. The NE height series does not hold. The K_NE probe (wall −325) runs straight onto A's finished south bar and courtyard, and the original strip st_K.png already shows the same dark band on 2026-03-27 and 04-28, when the NE part did not exist above ground. The '25 m Jul / 45 m Sep' values are artefacts. Only 'low frame in about Jul 2026' is supported.

checked.claim: DARYN F: near full height in Jul 2026 but only about 13/29/33 m 'beyond the wall' in Aug–Oct; topping-out Sep–Nov 2026
checked.evidence: Google g_FG.png shows F towers with NW shadows comparable to finished E's, so F was largely at height by about Jul 2026. The S2 F_S series gives 8–24 m in Aug–Oct 2026, which does not fit F already being near full height in Jul. The S2 numbers are measurement artefacts (shadow onto F itself), and the agent's own note admits this. Topping-out is more likely Jul–Sep 2026, so BI 05.06.2027 sits inside the agent's own 8–12-month calibration rather than at its 'optimistic edge'.

checked.claim: DARYN G: the slab was about 45 m by Jul–Aug 2026 and G6 was still rising in Oct 2026
checked.evidence: Probe G_sl: 0 until 06-02, then 25 (06-20), 29 (07-15), 44 (08-14), 34–39 (Sep) and 21 (10-13). Probe G6: 0 until 07-15, then 16 (08-14), 37 (09-08), ≥45 (09-20) and 32–36 (Oct). So the slab reached about 40–45 m in Aug rather than mid-Jul, and G6 rose Aug–Sep 2026. Google shows G6 as a frame in Jul. The direction of the claim (G last among the western blocks) holds, but the individual readings vary by ±10–15 m between methods.

checked.claim: TARIH A rose Oct–Dec 2025 and topped out about Dec 2025 – Jan 2026; TARIH B rose Dec 2025 – Feb 2026 and topped out about Feb–Mar 2026
checked.evidence: My montage mont_TARIH_winter.png: on 2025-10-28 a dark band already sits just north of T-A (a low structure). 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-18 show large blue shadows north of T-A. B shows only small patches on 12-27, a north-bar shadow band on 02-15 and a strong one on 02-25. Google g_TARIH.png (about Jul) shows A and B roofed, with courtyards still under works. Absolute heights are unmeasured, as the agent says.

checked.claim: TARIH C: about 26 m on 06-02, then a 27–30 m plateau (9 fl. + parapet), topped out about Jun–Jul 2026
checked.evidence: Timing is confirmed. A faint ring appears on 2026-02-25 and a clear ring on 03-17. Probe TC_N gives 12 (03-27), 9 (04-28), 27 (06-02), then 21–25 through 10-13. Probe TC_S plateaus at 22–26 from Aug. Google shows the closed square roofed around a bare concrete courtyard. The automated plateau is about 22–25 m, a few metres below the claimed 27–30 m. The '9 floors' figure is not derivable from imagery.

checked.claim: TARIH E north bar: about 9 m on 06-02, 17 m on 07-15, 24 m on 09-08 and 27 m on 10-13, reaching 9 floors only in Sep–Oct 2026; BI Q1 2027 not credible
checked.evidence: Google g_TCE.png (about Jul 2026): the TE north bar (x 200–290, y −390…−410) has a finished roof with hatches. Its NW shadow (to about y −365, about 25 m) is as long as or longer than the topped-out TARIH C north bar's (about 20–25 m). So the north bar was at about C's height already in about Jul. The S2 series contradicts the agent's own Google observation. The auto probe gives 9, 13, 17 and 15–21 m. The W tower section (x 215–235, y −425…−470) also casts a long shadow. Only the far SE part (x 255–285) was a low frame. Whole-block topping-out is more plausibly Aug–Oct 2026, so 'Aug–Dec 2027 keys' is likely too pessimistic. BI Q1 2027 remains aggressive (about 5–7 months).

checked.claim: Calibration: BI's topping-out-to-keys interval in this cluster is 8–12 months, based on A, B, D, E and K
checked.evidence: The calibration is circular. For E (24.12.2026) and K (17.10.2026) the 'keys' end is BI's own promised sheet date, not an observed handover. For D it is an owner ad. The only observed completions are A and B. Neither has a dated handover; they were physically finished and occupied in the about Jul 2026 Google image. B topped out about Sep–Oct 2025 and was occupied by about Jul 2026, so ≤9–10 months. The band is an assumption, not a measured fact. Applying it uniformly is what produces the late-2027/2028 dates.

corrections: DARYN D reached near-full height by about early or mid Oct 2025, not about Nov 2025 (S2: about 41–46 m on 2025-09-25, about 50 m on 10-10 and 10-28). Its plateau is about 45–51 m, not 48–53. The 'ключи ноябрь 2026' owner date still fits.

DARYN C1: no structure up to late Feb 2026 (snow scenes). It was roughly half-height (about 20–25 m) in the about-Jul 2026 Google image, not 'tall'. It was about 15–24 m on 09-08 and about 33–39 m on 10-07 and 10-13, so it was still rising in October. The '15 m would show at el 60°' argument is invalid, because a 15 m building casts under one S2 pixel of shadow at that sun height.

DARYN H: Google (about Jul 2026) shows the north, east and SW sections casting shadows comparable to B's (14 fl.). Topping-out is about Jul–Sep 2026, not Sep–Nov. BI 27.02.2027 is aggressive but not 'not achievable'. A realistic window is about Mar–Aug 2027, not Jul–Nov 2027.

DARYN F: Google shows F largely at height by about Jul 2026. The S2 Aug–Oct heights (13/29/33 m) are artefacts. Topping-out is about Jul–Sep 2026, and BI 05.06.2027 lies inside the agent's own calibration band rather than at its optimistic edge.

DARYN K NE part: the S2 heights (25 m Jul, 45 m Sep, ≥36 m Oct) are artefacts. The probe crosses A's finished south bar, and the same dark band is present in Mar–Apr 2026, before the part existed. Only 'low frame with formwork in about Jul 2026' (Google) is supported. Its topping-out date is unknown.

TARIH E: the north bar had a finished roof and a shadow as long as topped-out TARIH C's in about Jul 2026. The S2 series (17 m in Jul, 27 m in Oct) is wrong. Only the far SE part was a low frame. Whole-block topping-out is more likely Aug–Oct 2026, and keys about Q2–Q3 2027 rather than Aug–Dec 2027.
TARIH C: the automated plateau is about 22–25 m, not 27–30 m. The '9 floors' figure comes from elsewhere, not from imagery.
DARYN G slab: reached about 40–45 m in Aug 2026 rather than by 15 Jul (the auto probe gives 29 m on 07-15 and 44 m on 08-14).

Calibration: the 8–12 month topping-out-to-keys band is partly circular. It uses BI's own promised dates for E and K and an undated owner ad for D. Observed completions are only A and B, with undated handovers. The band should be labelled an assumption.
The Google mosaic date should be stated as 'about late Jun – mid Aug 2026' (correlation peak 15 Jul; 0.90 on 30 Jul and 14 Aug), not as a point date.
missing: No imagery gives any handover date. Commissioning acts (акт ввода), utility hook-ups and actual key handover need the state register, the BI office or a site visit.
Design floor counts per block and section (needed to judge whether a plateau means topped out) are not established from imagery. C1's '17 fl.' and TARIH's '9 fl.' come from other sources.
Section-level mapping (which korter or BI section a given ground-floor office is in) is not resolved, especially for K versus 'K-2', C1 versus C2–C3, and the TARIH E north bar versus the SE part.
The dates of the owner ads ('дом сдан', 'введен в эксплуатацию') are not given, so the A and B topping-out-to-keys intervals are only upper bounds.
D's block letter at Улы Дала 4 is inferred. OSM names that building only 'ЖК ŪIA.DARYN'.
I did not re-check the BI sheet dates themselves (24.12.2026, 17.10.2026, 27.02.2027, 31.03.2027, 05.06.2027, 25.09.2027). They are inputs here and were verified by another track.
There is no sub-metre imagery after about Jul 2026. Planet or Maxar from Sep–Oct 2026 would settle C1, H, F, G6, K NE and TARIH E heights.
verify.summary:
I re-ran the imagery track from the agent's own cached S2 scenes (work/L_*.npz), the Google mosaic and the Esri Wayback metadata. New renders are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-ispeo-saraptama-kz/9c75da6f-017a-59fc-9a5e-c9e0d03d9df9/scratchpad/geo/handover_verify_imagery/: sh.json (automated shadow probes, 21 probes × 19 dates), st_C1_H.png, st_A_early.png, mont_east_winter.png, mont_mid.png, mont_C_spring.png, mont_TARIH_winter.png, and the Google crops g_AK, g_B, g_C1, g_CMH, g_H, g_FG, g_TARIH and g_TCE.

The robust findings hold:
- The Esri capture is 2024-09-17.
- The Google mosaic is about Jul 2026.
- DARYN A and B were physically complete, landscaped and occupied.
- D, E, K's main part, TARIH A, B and C were topped out by mid-2026.
- C1 had no structure until spring 2026 and was still rising in Oct 2026, so 'C keys 26.12.2026 / Q4 2026' is not credible.
- M was a bare raft in Jul and about 1–2 storeys in Oct 2026, so 31.03.2027 is impossible.
- Lot A is piles only.
- K's NE part was a low frame in Jul 2026, so 17.10.2026 cannot apply to it.

The weak part is the S2 height series for blocks whose shadows fall on other buildings or dark ground. The K NE, H, F and TARIH E numbers are contradicted by the agent's own Google observations or are probe artefacts.

Correcting them moves H, F and TARIH E topping-out earlier, to about Jul–Oct 2026. That softens the agent's 'BI date not credible' verdicts for H (27.02.2027) and TARIH E (Q1 2027) to 'aggressive', and makes F's 05.06.2027 consistent with the agent's own model.

The 8–12-month topping-out-to-keys calibration is partly circular, because it uses BI's promised dates as observations. All handover windows remain model estimates, not facts.
